description: Ranta10 - rantaviiva 1:10 000 is a dataset listed in Open Data Finland, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Suomen ympäristökeskus (Syke). Ranta10 is a topologically coherent spatial dataset describing Finnish water bodies. The data is based on data from the National Land Survey's terrain database for 2000-2008 (1:5 000-1:10 000). Coverage: Suomen ympäristökeskus (Syke). The portal shows the English title as "Beach10 - coastline 1:10 000" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Suomen ympäristökeskus (Syke). Its keywords include hydrography, ei-inspire, lake, syken-kansallisella-rajapinnalla, sea-regions, paikkatietoaineisto. The listing shows 5 download or service links in ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-finland.
